items.headline: GPT-6 models demonstrate intrinsic protein-design capabilities
items.excerpt: GPT-6 models design protein structures and sequences using reasoning and code. Lab tests found evidence of binding across five targets.

items.headline: Searching for distant planets with Astra
items.excerpt: See how two amateur astronomers used Codex and Astra to find potential exoplanets in public data from NASA’s Kepler and TESS space telescopes.

items.headline: How Intentful uses dots to make more time for growth
items.excerpt: Marina Petrova’s dot Aria helps research websites and build proposals, while proactively flagging messages and resolving issues.

items.headline: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories
items.excerpt: How iFood scales coding agents across 15,000 repositories

items.headline: Clay helps sales teams win with Codex and ChatGPT
items.excerpt: ChatGPT and Codex integrations help Clay’s users research deals and turn data into go-to-market plays, with GPT-6 models handling the reasoning.

items.headline: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
items.excerpt: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo, an open-source runtime for Linux. It helps teams protect running systems while they roll out patches.

items.headline: Connected intelligence for in-house legal
items.excerpt: Watch OpenAI’s Stacey Wang and Craig Bruney, Mary O’Carroll of LECG, and Cooley’s Richard Segal explore how AI can help in-house legal teams connect business context, build reusable workflows and get more from outside counsel.

items.headline: Richpanel helps companies automate 50% of support in 30 days
items.excerpt: Richpanel uses GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to equip its AI support agents with tools and procedures, and GPT-6 Luna for their conversations.

items.headline: Perplexity and Intelligence
items.excerpt: How perplexity measures progress in AI models, and why it could help developers establish a shared approach to evaluating emerging capabilities.
